body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Sharp(www.sharp.com) introduced Mobile 3D Camcorder 'Mobile 3D' in one hand at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA, for 4 days from January 6.
2 lenses are loaded at the back side of product and at the onsite of CES 2011, Sharp demonstrated 3D shooting through 'Mobile 3D'.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
